episodes.title: Alpha
episodes.summary: Welcome to Manchester college. Caroline enlists Lucien's help to recruit the Vice President's daughter Annie Grover to join Delta Phi. Cece persuades Professor Chadwick to give her a coveted TA position.

episodes.title: Beta
episodes.summary: Caroline plans for President's Night. Annie decides between rushing and her friend Beatrice's anti-greek movement. Blaise pitches Scott as the new Alpha Gamma president.

episodes.title: Gamma
episodes.summary: With some help from Cece, Caroline and Blaise ally to secure Scott's presidential run. Lucien and Annie play hooky. Beatrice celebrates her anti-greek victory with plans for more.

episodes.title: Delta
episodes.summary: Professor Chadwick's ex-wife comes to campus for her book tour. Annie and Caroline grow closer. Blaise suggests he and Scott strategically take some space.

episodes.title: Epsilon
episodes.summary: Caroline introduces her mother to Annie and her family. Annie and Scott take their relationship to the next level. Lucien discovers Blaise's secret. Cece spends a revelatory day with Professor Chadwick.

episodes.title: Zeta
episodes.summary: It's Lucien's birthday. Lucien attempts to seal the deal with Annie. Cece tries to seduce Professor Chadwick. Scott acts out against Blaise and everyone else. Caroline's big party backfires.

episodes.title: Eta
episodes.summary: The Greeks are in trouble with the National Board after the big party. Scott discovers money is missing from the frat. Annie and Lucien grow closer. Caroline does what's necessary to get things back in order.

episodes.title: Theta
episodes.summary: Lucien's secrets are all over campus. Blaise visits Congressman Russell. Professor Chadwick is under investigation. And Caroline is determined to win Annie for Delta Phi as everything comes to a head in this season finale.
